# SEO audit and improvement plan — whole site

Date: 2026-11-15
Previous work: [song.page.seo.md](song.page.seo.md) (song page only, 2026-10-19..21).

## Goal

The site sells nothing. The only goal is that people find what they look for, in their language. Everything commercial is ignored.

Five kinds of search must work. Each needs one clear landing page.

| # | The person looks for | Typical query | Landing page | State today |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| I1 | A song by its **first line** | `parama karuna pahu dui jana lyrics` | Song page | First line is not in `<title>`; text is not in the HTML (F1, F4) |
| I2 | A song by its **title** | `gaura nityananda daya`, `Шаранагати текст` | Song page | Title is in `<title>` and `<h1>`; must stay there when the first line is added (Q3) |
| I3 | **Songs by an author** | `songs by Bhaktivinod Thakur`, `песни Нароттама Даса Тхакура` | A page per author | No such page: one long authors page with anchors (F29) |
| I4 | A **translation** of a song | `… translation`, `… meaning`, `… перевод`, `… traducción` | Song page in the reader's language | Translation is not in the HTML; other-language versions are linked only inside a modal (F1, F20, F31) |
| I5 | **Audio recordings** of a song, or of a singer | `… audio`, `… mp3`, `слушать …`, `Govinda Maharaj kirtans` | Song page (one song), singer page (one singer), audio index | Pages exist, but song pages do not say they have audio and singer pages have weak titles (F30) |

Queries are usually typed **without diacritics** (F16).

## How the audit was done

- Read the metadata, JSON-LD, sitemap, robots and view code.
- Parsed the built static HTML in `out/` (build of 2026-11-14) for every page type: title, description, canonical, hreflang, headings, links, images, visible text, JSON-LD.
- Fetched the live raw HTML of `https://kirtan.site/en/akrodha-paramananda/` with `curl` (no JavaScript) and checked the live `robots.txt`, sitemap and host redirects.
- Counted content facts per songbook from `source/books/*` (titles vs first lines, translations, word-by-word, title lengths, overlap between editions).
- Used the seo-optimizer skill checklist as the list of things to check. Section 8 lists which parts of it were deliberately not applied.

Not done: no Search Console / Bing / Yandex data was available, and no Lighthouse run. Steps that depend on them are marked **measure first**.

## 1. What is already good

| Area | State |
|---|---|
| Static HTML for every URL, trailing-slash canonicals, `www` and `http` 301 to `https://kirtan.site/` | OK |
| `robots.txt` in production (`/data/`, `/shell/`, `/*/search/` disallowed), sitemap with 1138 URLs | OK |
| Song pages: canonical, description template in 6 languages, `music.song` OG, JSON-LD `WebPage` + `BreadcrumbList` + `MusicComposition` + recordings | OK |
| Audio pages: unique title, generated description, `ItemList` of recordings, breadcrumb | OK |
| Legacy `.html` URLs: redirect pages with canonical | OK |
| Semantic markup on the song page (`article`, one `h1`, `nav`) | OK |

## 2. Findings

Ordered by how much they block the goal. "Evidence" is what was observed, not assumed.

### Critical

| # | Finding | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| F1 | **Song text is not in the HTML.** The static page contains a loading skeleton instead of verses and translation. The text exists only inside the script payload and appears after JavaScript runs. | Live raw HTML: `lyrics in visible body: false`, `SongLoader` present. Visible text of the song page is 44 words (header, singer names, footer). Cause: `SongText` starts with `mode = null` and renders `SongLoader` until an effect reads `localStorage`. |
| F2 | **hreflang points to the wrong book** when several books share a language (`en`, `en-pe`, `en-2022`; `ru`, `ru-kdm`). The last book wins the language key. | Live `/en/akrodha-paramananda/`: `hreflang="en"` → `/en-2022/…` (a hidden book), and the page does not list itself. Index pages on `/en/…`: `hreflang="ru"` → `/ru-kdm/…`. |
| F3 | **Same-language editions are indexable duplicates.** Every edition is self-canonical. Hidden books are only left out of the sitemap. | Overlap by slug: `en-2022` 158 of 166 songs are in `en`; `en-pe` 79 of 81; `ru-kdm` 23 of 23. |
| F4 | **The first line is missing from `<title>` and `<h1>`** although people search by first line. | The title differs from the first line in about 80% of songs (`en` 172 of 213, `ru` 143 of 183). The first line is in the description only when the composed sentence is short, and in JSON-LD `alternateName`. |
| F5 | **`/` is an empty document**: no title, no description, no text, no links, only a JavaScript redirect. It is not in the sitemap. | `out/index.html`: 1 word, 0 links, no `<title>`. |
| F6 | **The book list page `/en/` has no books in its HTML.** | 14 words, 5 links (footer only), no `h1`. Cause: `BookCard` returns `null` until `useHiddenBooks` runs its effect. |

Note on F1: Google does run JavaScript, so it most likely sees the text, but later and less reliably than plain HTML. Bing, Yandex, DuckDuckGo and AI crawlers mostly read the raw HTML and get no lyrics at all. This is the single most valuable fix.

### High

| # | Finding | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| F7 | **All index pages of a book share one title.** | `/en/`, `/en/contents/`, `/en/a-z/`, `/en/authors/`, `/en/search/` → `Kīrtan Guide 12th Ed \| Kirtan Site`. |
| F8 | **Index page descriptions are stubs.** | `Contents` (8 chars), `Index list A-Z` (14), `Authors list` (12), `List of available songbooks` (27). Better texts already exist under `*.SCHEMA.DESCRIPTION` but are used only in JSON-LD. |
| F9 | **Song descriptions promise things the page does not have.** | `en` says "word-by-word meaning" on all 213 songs; 0 have word-by-word. `ua` says "з українським перекладом"; 96 of 166 songs have no translation. |
| F10 | **Song `<title>` is too long and reads badly.** | 45% of titles exceed 60 chars (`en` 95 of 213). The length fallback cannot shorten a song that has an author but no subtitle. The `en` author field already starts with "by", giving `… Rāya. by Śrīla …`. |
| F11 | **`<html lang="ua">` for Ukrainian** (invalid code; should be `uk`). Same in index-page JSON-LD `inLanguage`. | `AppDocument` and `LdJson` use `bookId.slice(0, 2)` instead of `getBookLocale`. |
| F12 | **Prev / next song links are not in the HTML.** | `PrevNextNav` returns `null` until hydration (`usePageQuery()` is `null` on the server). A song page has 7 unique internal links, none to another song. |
| F13 | **`x-default` differs on every language version** (each page names itself). | All audited pages. It should be one URL for the whole group. |
| F29 | **No landing page for "songs by an author"** (I3). All authors share one page with `#section-…` anchors; it has no `<h1>`, the shared book title, and the description `Authors list`. Author names appear only with diacritics. | `en` has 25 authors: 11 with two or more songs (82, 28, 18, 14, 7, 5, 4, 3, 3, 2, 2) and 14 with one. Author names are written per book and have no id shared between languages. |
| F30 | **Audio is hard to find from search** (I5). Song pages with audio do not mention it in the title or description. Singer page titles lack the words "audio" / "recordings", every singer page has the same `<h1>`, and the singer description is generic. Track lists show only first lines, not titles. | `en`: 135 of 213 songs have audio. Singer page: title `Srila B.S. Govinda Dev-Goswami Maharaj – Kīrtan Guide 12th Ed \| Kirtan Site` (75 chars), `<h1>` `Kirtan audio recordings`, description 101 chars with no song names. |
| F31 | **Translations are hard to find from search** (I4). The translation text is not in the HTML (F1), the word "translation" appears only in the description, and it is claimed even when the song has none (F9). | See F1, F9, F20. |

### Medium

| # | Finding | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| F14 | Heading structure of index pages: every list item is an `<h6>`, the book name is an `<h3>` before the `<h1>`, there are no `<h2>`. The authors page has no `<h1>`. | Contents: 239 `h6`; A–Z: 277 `h6`. |
| F15 | Index-page JSON-LD is only a bare `CollectionPage`: no list of songs, no breadcrumb. | `LdJson.tsx`. |
| F16 | Diacritics. Texts use IAST (`paramānanda`) and Cyrillic with combining marks (`корун̣а`, `ш́рӣла`). People type `paramananda`, `коруна`, `шрила`. Whether engines match these is unknown, especially Yandex with Cyrillic. | 97–100% of first lines contain non-ASCII characters. **Measure first.** |
| F17 | Markdown pages (`en` only, 10 pages): title has no book or site name, description equals the title, no excerpt. JSON-LD was added after the audited build and needs a check. | `Framework of The Daily Programme` (32 chars) for both. |
| F18 | Sitemap: no `lastmod`; includes one `(hidden)` item; will include duplicates until F3 is fixed. | `app/sitemap.ts`. |
| F19 | `MusicComposition.name` contains the author (`… Rāya. by Śrīla …`). It should be the plain title. | `LdJsonSong.tsx` uses `getSongPageTitle(song)`. |
| F20 | Links to the same song in other languages exist only inside a closed modal, so they are not in the HTML. | `OtherTranslations` + `AppModal`. hreflang partly covers this. |

### Low

| # | Finding |
|---|---|
| F21 | Nine `<meta name="author">` tags (the songwriters list) on every index page. Noise. |
| F22 | Images have no `width` / `height` (header logo, book thumbnail, book banners). Possible layout shift. |
| F23 | OG image is the 640×380 book banner for every song (old deferred item 12). Affects link previews, not search. |
| F24 | `og:locale` is `en`, `ru`; the format should be `en_US`, `ru_RU`. |
| F25 | The audio index links every singer twice, once with `?autoplay=1`. Canonical handles it; it only wastes crawling. |
| F26 | `404.html` renders nothing on the server (no `<html lang>`, no title, no links). It is `noindex`, so only usability for crawlers following dead links. |
| F27 | Word-by-word text is not in the HTML in the default view (closed `Collapse` does not render its content). Matters mostly for `es` (145 songs). |
| F28 | 96 `ua` songs have no Ukrainian translation, so those pages are close to the `en-2022` transliteration. Content matter, not code. |

## 3. Decisions needed before starting

Each has a recommended default; work can start on the defaults.

| # | Question | Recommended |
|---|---|---|
| Q1 | **Which book is primary per language?** | The book whose id equals the language code (`en`, `ru`, `es`, `pt`, `lv`, `ua`). `en-pe`, `en-2022`, `ru-kdm` are secondary. Later this can become a `language` / `primary` field in the songbook info (already in `todo.md`). |
| Q2 | **What to do with a secondary-edition song that also exists in the primary book?** | `rel="canonical"` to the primary book's page, leave it out of the sitemap, keep the page itself working. Songs that exist only in a secondary edition stay self-canonical: indexable for visible books (`en-pe`), `noindex, follow` for hidden books. Index pages of hidden books: `noindex, follow`. |
| Q3 | **Title order when the first line differs from the title.** | First line first: `{First line} – {Title} \| Kirtan Site`, because the first line is what people type and the end is what gets cut. **Both** the first line and the title always stay (I1, I2); when the result is too long, the site name is dropped, never one of the two. |
| Q4 | **Root `/`.** | Keep the redirect for visitors. Add a real static page under it: title, description, `h1`, and a plain list of all songbooks as links. Use `/en/` as `x-default` everywhere. (Alternative: make `/` a true language chooser with no automatic redirect for new visitors. Cleaner for search, but changes what first-time visitors see.) |
| Q5 | **View-mode flash.** After F1 the server renders the default view (verses + translation). A visitor who saved "verses only" sees the translation for a moment before it hides. | Accept it first, and measure. If it is noticeable, add a small inline script that copies the saved mode to an attribute on `<html>` so CSS hides the parts before the first paint. |
| Q6 | **Author pages: which authors, and what id?** | A page for every author with two or more songs; single-song authors stay only on the all-authors page. The id is a plain-ASCII slug of the author's name in that book. Language versions of an author page are then not linked by hreflang, because nothing in the data says that `Śrīla Bhakti Vinod Ṭhākur` and `Ш́рӣла Бхактивинод Т̣ха̄кур` are the same person. A shared author id in the song data (like `personSlug` for singers) would fix that later. |

## 4. Plan

One batch per session. Once A and B are done, batches C, D, E, G and H are independent of each other, except that H1 is part of the description work in C3.

Highest impact, small code.

| Step | Change | Files |

Read the saved modes after mount (or through `useSyncExternalStore` with the defaults as the server snapshot). Remove `SongLoader` if nothing else uses it. | `components/song/SongText/SongText.tsx`, `SongLoader.tsx` |

| A4 | `PrevNextNav`: on the server render the links of the first page variation; switch to the `?p=` variation after hydration. | `components/song/PrevNextNav/PrevNextNav.tsx` |
| A5 | `<html lang>` and index JSON-LD `inLanguage` through `getBookLocale`. | `components/app/AppDocument.tsx`, `other/metadata/LdJson.tsx` |

### Batch M — measure, then decide (F16, F22–F25, performance)

| M1 | Search Console, Bing Webmaster and **Yandex Webmaster** (Russian and Ukrainian readers): submit the sitemap; after Batch A use URL inspection to confirm the crawled HTML contains the lyrics. |
| M2 | Diacritics test: search `site:kirtan.site` plus a first line typed plainly (`parama karuna pahu dui jana`, `парама коруна паху дуи джана`) in Google and Yandex. If pages are not found, add a visible plain-spelling line to the song page (for example a small "also written as" line) and to the A–Z index. If they are found, do nothing more than C4. |

### Later ideas (not planned)

- A shared author id in the song data, so author pages of different languages can be linked by hreflang (Q6).
- A `Book` JSON-LD node per songbook, with songs as its parts.
- A link from each songbook to the publisher's page on scsmath.com (already in `todo.md`).

## 5. Suggested order

1. **Batch A** — nothing else matters much while the lyrics are not in the HTML.
2. **Batch B** — stops the editions from competing with each other.
3. **Batch C** — first line and title in `<title>`, honest descriptions, visible links to translations.
4. **Batch D** — index pages.
5. **Batch G** — author pages.
6. **Batch H** — audio recordings.
7. **Batch E** — root and the rest.
8. **Batch M** — runs in parallel from the day Batch A is deployed.

Coverage of the five searches: I1 and I2 need A + C; I3 needs G (and D for the all-authors page); I4 needs A + B + C; I5 needs C + H.

## 6. How to verify each batch

```sh
pnpm run type-check && pnpm run lint
pnpm run build:local
```

Then, on `out/`:

- Raw HTML check without a browser: the song page contains verse text; `/en/` contains the book links; `/` has a title.
- For one song in several editions and languages: print canonical, robots and hreflang of every version and check they agree with each other.
- No two pages of the same book share a `<title>`; every description is between 70 and 160 chars.
- Sitemap: URL count drops by about the number of duplicate edition songs; no hidden books or `(hidden)` items.
- One check per search kind, on a song whose title differs from its first line and that has an author, a translation and audio:
  - I1, I2: both the first line and the title are in `<title>` and in the page text.
  - I3: the song links to its author page, and that page lists the song by title and first line.
  - I4: the translation text is in the raw HTML; the page links to its other-language versions; hreflang agrees with those links.
  - I5: the description mentions audio; each singer link leads to a singer page whose title names the singer and "audio".
- Rich Results Test / Schema validator on: a song with audio, a song without author, the contents page, a markdown page.
- Visual check that nothing moved: song page in all three view modes, Learn mode, contents, A–Z, authors, book list.

The audit used a small script that prints title, description, canonical, hreflang, headings, link and word counts for given files in `out/`. Keeping such a script in `scripts/` would make these checks repeatable; decide in Batch A.

## 7. Files involved

- Metadata: `other/metadata/*`, `other/metadata/helpers/*`, `lib/content/song/meta.ts`, `lib/content/page/meta.ts`
- JSON-LD: `other/metadata/LdJson.tsx`, `LdJsonSong.tsx`, `LdJsonPage.tsx`, `LdJsonAudio.tsx`
- Crawl: `app/sitemap.ts`, `app/robots.ts`, `scripts/postbuild.js`
- Documents: `components/app/AppDocument.tsx`, `app/page.tsx`, `app/global-not-found.tsx`
- Song view: `components/song/SongText/*`, `components/song/Verse/*`, `components/song/PrevNextNav/*`, `components/content/ContentShell.tsx`
- Index views: `components/app/views/*`, `components/contents/*`, `components/a-z/*`, `components/authors/*`, `components/home/*`, `components/common/IndexLink/*`, `components/common/BookDescription/*`
- Strings: `source/translations.json`, `scripts/validation/validationSchema.js`
- Instructions to update when behaviour changes: `paths.instructions.md` (canonical / hreflang rules), `app-routes.instructions.md`, `app-architecture.instructions.md`

## 8. Parts of the SEO skill not applied, and why

| Skill item | Why not |
|---|---|
| Keyword research by volume and difficulty, keyword density targets | The "keywords" are fixed: each song's first line, title and author. Nothing to choose. |
| Content length targets, article structure, calls to action | The content is the song text. It must not be padded. |
| Commercial and transactional intent, conversion tracking | Nothing is sold. |
| Local SEO, business profile | Not a local business. |
| FAQ / HowTo / Product / Review schema | Do not describe this content. |
| Topic clusters and pillar articles | The book → contents → song structure already is the cluster; Batch D strengthens it. |
| Backlink building | Out of scope. One relevant idea is listed under "Later ideas". |
| `SearchAction` | Skipped in the previous plan for reasons that still hold. |
